_meta.identityConfidenceReason: Confirmed via operator's own website (outerreefsurfschool.com), Google Maps listing embedded on their Contact page (Unit 4, Upper Lamphey Road, Pembroke SA71 5JJ), and corroborating TripAdvisor listing (Outer Reef, Pembroke, Pembrokeshire, Wales, g552048-d6495762) showing hundreds of reviews and a Travellers' Choice Award.
redFlags: REGION MISMATCH: This operator is referenced by combo pages for pembrokeshire, brecon-beacons, gower, anglesey, llyn-peninsula, south-wales, and mid-wales, but it is a single-location Pembrokeshire business. Its own site states it teaches only at Pembrokeshire beaches (Freshwater West, Manorbier, Newgale, Tenby North, Saundersfoot, Broadhaven) and its address/phone are Pembroke-based. No evidence of any presence in Brecon Beacons, Gower, Anglesey, Llyn Peninsula, or Mid Wales — these region associations should be removed from combo pages. 'South Wales' is defensible only in the loose sense that Pembrokeshire is part of south-west Wales, but the business does not describe or market itself as a South Wales-wide operator.

No numeric Google star rating could be independently sourced; operator's own site claims '200+ five-star Google reviews' but does not display an aggregate score, so googleRating is left null rather than guessed.

proposedOperatorData.description:
Outer Reef Surf School has operated in Pembrokeshire since 1999, teaching surfing, stand-up paddleboarding, coasteering and kayaking on the county's beaches. Lessons run daily from April to November, with the day's beach chosen from a rotation of six spots (Freshwater West, Manorbier, Newgale, Tenby North, Saundersfoot and Broadhaven) depending on conditions. Instructors are ISA-certified surf and SUP coaches who also hold SLSGB beach lifeguard qualifications; the school states it has taught over 25,000 people to date.

A standard 2-hour group surf lesson costs £40 per person, with equipment (wetsuit and board) included. The school also runs multi-activity packages combining surfing, SUP and coasteering, private and family lessons, equipment hire, and a women-only 'Salty Sisters' surf club. It holds an AALA adventure activities licence and £10m public liability insurance, and has a TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Award with several hundred reviews.

The business is based at a retail unit in Pembroke town (open daily 9am-5pm) but does not have a fixed teaching venue — the beach used depends on daily surf and tide conditions across Pembrokeshire only.
